notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Will, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Will.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Will.
Repeat from step 4.
